data.body: Regression from this ticket's landed change ce11e259f8e (2026-11-20 PST): test_a_slow_local_git_call_does_not_fail_the_repair_pause fails on every Windows sweep of main (runs 44838478830 and 44846502029, sweep (windows); it is that job's only failure) with FileNotFoundError on its delayed-update-refs log. Cause: the PATH shim is a Python script named `git`; Windows process creation looks only for git.exe, so the shim never ran and no update-ref was delayed. Fix (commit aab2a2d9ff9, branch fix-squamata-windows): wrap gitutil._run_in_group so `git` argvs run through `sys.executable shim.py` inside the same timed process-group call, and have the shim run git as a child instead of os.execv (execv on Windows returns before git finishes). macOS: with the session headroom set back to 5.0 s the test fails with 'git update-ref refs/reconciler/gate timed out after 5.0s'; with the 60 s headroom it passes (1 passed, 13.7 s). Windows validation run 44863666241 on tmp/squamata-win; make verify running via the slot cap. This blocks hydra's and bluet's three-consecutive-green-sweep criterion until it lands.
